CustomField.description: Optional allowlist of the values the facet offers, as picklist API values (or true/false for a checkbox) separated by semicolons, shown in this order. Checked against the field's active values at runtime; unknown values are skipped and logged. Blank offers every active value. Visitors' selections outside the list are ignored. Text (255), not Long Text Area: getAll() returns long text area values cut at 255 characters, and visitors can't query the config types.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. Which values to offer, in this order, separated by semicolons (New;Working;Escalated). Use API values, not labels. Leave blank to offer every active value.
CustomField.label: Values
